title_en: Aritha - The Field of Val Papadi (Flat Beans)
translation: It is said that once Sadguru Shri Jivanji Maharaj came to the home of the devotee Shri Haridas of Nadiad, in a village named Aritha. At that time the summer season was in progress. In the height of summer all the farmers' crops had dried up. At that time Jivanji Maharaj made the devotee Vaishnav Haridasji's field of val papadi (flat beans) turn green and showed it so. This brought great joy to all the devotees. Even today this field lies at the edge of the village.
